fields.name: thermal_conductivity
fields.rationale: Thermal conductivity is a key property for insulation materials, indicating how well the material can prevent heat transfer.

fields.name: water_vapour_resistance
fields.rationale: Water vapour resistance is crucial for insulation materials to prevent moisture ingress, which can lead to energy loss and material degradation.
evidence: extremely high resistance to water vapour transmission

fields.name: production_process
fields.rationale: The production process can affect the material properties and applications of the insulation product.
evidence: pressureless, continuous and discontinuous production process
